law: A claim without evidence is a wish; evidence without a claim is an undocumented constraint. Magnitudes live in bootstrap/validation_registry.json (W093 single source of truth); provenance and assumptions live here and are never duplicated.

validation_classes.ANALYTIC: closed-form/analytic reference executed by the R0.6 harness (scripts/validation/harness.py, fixture schema r06-fixture-v1)
validation_classes.ORACLE: mirrored-expectation rows of bootstrap/validation_registry.json (python oracle, W093)
validation_classes.DIFFERENTIAL: two-lane VM vs tree-walk byte parity over the shared corpus
validation_classes.BEHAVIORAL: containment/pass assertions without a numeric expectation
validation_classes.BENCHMARK: measured performance characteristic guarded by the regression gate

claims.model: Hill dose-response, thresholded activating edge (n=2): the EC50 identity and the five canonical curve points
primary_sources: Alon, An Introduction to Systems Biology, ch. 2 (Hill-Langmuir input function; EC50 = half-max point)
equations: influence = strength * level^n / (level^n + threshold^n), n=2 default, so threshold t IS the EC50 (SPEC section 11 mapping)

parameter_provenance.param: threshold t, strength s canonical values

assumptions: deterministic engine: same binary + source + seed + flags + cell gives byte-identical stdout (docs/spec/DETERMINISM.md section 1)
op-order-exact evaluation, repeated multiplication never powi (W090 IEEE-754 parity contract); levels are normalized 0..1, not concentrations

claims.model: Repressilator ring period: three-repressor ring oscillator period pinned to 6 ticks under T2d discrete integration
primary_sources: Elowitz & Leibler (2000), Nature 403:335, synthetic three-repressor ring
equations: dA/dt = alpha/(1+R^4) - gamma*A (alpha=10, gamma=1, n=4), 20 Euler substeps x dt=0.05 per ring tick (1 tick = 1.0 dimensionless time)

parameter_provenance.source: Elowitz-Leibler 2000 published ring, parameterized per SPEC section 11

assumptions: deterministic mode for byte-parity (stochastic mode uses seeded telegraph noise; the period claim is made in deterministic mode)
period pinned by peak-count-in-window (discrete, exact), amplitudes pinned stateless-fold-identical (W089) only
relaxation from initial condition is documented, not a published-number claim

claims.model: Ring kinetics parameter overlay: last-declaration-wins per field (alpha, gamma, hill, basal, noise, seed)
primary_sources: Elowitz & Leibler (2000), Nature 403:335 (parameter space); SPEC section 11 repressilator row (overlay semantics)
equations: parameter overlay layers onto the shared engine state; last declaration wins per field (SPEC section 11)
assumptions: deterministic engine (DETERMINISM.md section 1); differential tests pin the parameter plumbing to the oracle mirror

claims.model: trp attenuation: ribosome-speed-coupled transcription attenuation as an RNA-level veto with dose threshold
equations: leader-peptide/terminator-hairpin outcome modeled as a veto with dose threshold; no anti-terminator structure modeling (BIO-CONTRACT APPROX note)

parameter_provenance.source: SPEC attenuation row; behavioral outcome contract

assumptions: two-state outcome approximation (no codon-level ribosome kinetics, per BIO-CONTRACT)
mechanism labeled APPROXIMATION-class in BIO-CONTRACT; claim inherits that honesty boundary

claims.model: Cis riboswitch: per-gene 5'UTR metabolite sensor over a cell-wide metabolite pool, bound-state polarity per ligand class
primary_sources: cis-acting metabolite-binding aptamers: TPP/purine/SAM off class vs adenine/glycine on class (Serganov & Nudler 2013 review)
equations: @riboswitch(ligand, sense, threshold): bound-state polarity per class over the shared metabolite pool (SPEC riboswitch row)

parameter_provenance.source: Serganov & Nudler 2013 classification, mapped in SPEC

assumptions: ligand-level switch approximation (not kinetic aptamer folding)
cis requirement enforced (the aptamer lives on the transcript it controls; loop-9 wave B4 fixed this honesty point)

claims.model: Stoichiometric RISC silencing: guides are consumed (stoichiometric dose) on silence edges
primary_sources: RNA interference / siRNA-guided degradation, stoichiometric consumption of guides (RNAi literature; BIO-CONTRACT RISC row)
equations: silence old -> new strength s sites n: silencing consumes guide capacity stoichiometrically (registry V6 dose mapping)
assumptions: no off-target modeling (BIO-CONTRACT note)
stoichiometric consumption is the dose-carrying approximation; guide pool not otherwise modeled

claims.model: Occupancy repression: multiplicative thermodynamic occupancy on inhibiting edges
claims.bio_contract_note: No BIO-CONTRACT row yet for the occupy construct (only the RISC/marks rows exist); gap exposed here by rule 4 — row filing is the follow-up. Provenance and numerical evidence are complete in registry row V7.
primary_sources: thermodynamic occupancy models of transcription-factor binding (occupancy = fraction of sites bound; classical statistical-mechanical treatment)
equations: repression factor as multiplicative occupancy on inhibiting edges (registry V7 mapping)
assumptions: equilibrium occupancy approximation (no kinetic on/off rates)
multiplicative composition of independent inhibitor occupancies

claims.model: Gene dosage: @copies n read-side dose amplification on GRN edges
claims.bio_contract_note: No BIO-CONTRACT row yet for @copies; gap exposed here by rule 4 — row filing is the follow-up. Provenance and numerical evidence are complete in registry row V8.
primary_sources: gene dosage effects on expression level (copy-number dose response; molecular genetics literature)
equations: read-side amplification of regulated output proportional to copy number (registry V8 mapping)
assumptions: linear read-side dose scaling (no saturation or titration modeling)
amplification applies at read-out, not at the regulatory input

claims.model: Uniform sample mean converges to (a+b)/2 with the CLT z-gate and a byte-exact determinism pin
primary_sources: CLT for the sample mean of U(a,b); closed form E[U(a,b)] = (a+b)/2, Var = (b-a)^2/12 (probability literature)
equations: mean = (a+b)/2; variance of the mean of n samples = (b-a)^2/12/n; z = (observed - mean)/sqrt(var) gated at z_alpha = 0.001
assumptions: seeded xorshift64* stream is deterministic and exactly reproducible (R0.5 premise)
sample-size/CLT regime of the fixture (n fixed by the fixture program)

claims.model: Bernoulli sample proportion converges to p with the CLT z-gate and determinism pin
primary_sources: CLT for Bernoulli proportions; E = p, Var = p(1-p) (probability literature)
equations: mean = p; variance of the mean of n samples = p(1-p)/n; z-gate at the fixture's z_alpha
assumptions: seeded xorshift64* stream deterministic (R0.5 premise)
Bernoulli mapping in the R0.6 harness reference implementation (kind: bernoulli)

claims.model: Binomial pmf matches the closed form at the fixture's parameter point (total-variation gate over the support)
primary_sources: binomial distribution pmf C(n,k) p^k (1-p)^(n-k) (probability literature)
equations: pmf support compared by total-variation distance against the closed form, gate at the fixture's tv bound
assumptions: seeded xorshift64* stream deterministic (R0.5 premise)
pmf support enumerated exactly over {0..n}

claims.model: Geometric waiting-time distribution matches the closed form (exact bisection quantiles)
primary_sources: geometric distribution on {1,2,...}: P(X=k) = (1-p)^(k-1) p (probability literature)
equations: quantiles computed by exact bisection on the closed-form cdf; fixture compares observed quantiles
assumptions: seeded xorshift64* stream deterministic (R0.5 premise)
support convention {1,2,...} fixed by the R0.6 reference implementation

claims.model: Two-state Markov chain stationary distribution and spectral variance match the closed form
primary_sources: two-state Markov chain stationary distribution pi = (b/(a+b), a/(a+b)) with exact spectral variance (1+lam)/(1-lam) form (Markov chain literature)
equations: stationary distribution closed form + exact spectral variance (1+lam)/(1-lam) as derived in the R0.6 reference table
assumptions: seeded xorshift64* stream deterministic (R0.5 premise)
chain is ergodic at the fixture's parameters (a+b > 0)

claims.model: Deterministic RNG: std/random mirrors xorshift64* with an exactly pinned stream
primary_sources: Marsaglia, xorshift RNGs (Journal of Statistical Software 2003); xorshift64* variant with the multiplicative finalizer
equations: x ^= x >> 12; x ^= x << 25; x ^= x >> 27; stream value = x * 2685821657736338717 (the xorshift64* finalizer), as mirrored by std/random

parameter_provenance.source: tests/std_random.op pinned stream values (registry 'exact' comparison kind per W093)

assumptions: pure-integer stream: exact comparison is defensible (no floating-point slack), per the W093 registry 'exact' kind
single global stream instance per run under the deterministic-core premise
